paite: Philistia mite'n Israel adou ua; huchi in Israel mite Philistia mite ma ah ataikek ua, Gilboa tang ah thah in a-om uhi.
heading: Kumpipa Saul Sihna / (1 Sam 31.1-13)

paite: Philistia mite'n Saul leh atapate adelh vengveng ua; Philistia mite'n Jonathan, Abinadab leh Malki-shua, Saul tapate athat uhi.
Huchi in kidouna Saul a ding in ahaksa mahmahta a, thalkap mite'n amah aphata uh; huan thalkap mite ziak in alungkham mahmah hi.

Huchih lai in Saul in agalvan popa kiang ah, "Na namsau dokkhia inla, huai in hon dawt pailet in; huchi lou in zaw hiai zeksumlouhte hong pai in bawl louhlouh in ahon bawl kha ding uh," achi a. Himahleh agalvan popa a-ut kei; alau mahmah ngal a. Huaiziak in Saul in anamsau ala a kisiatna in aneita hi.
Agalvan popa'n Saul asita chih atheih in, huai bangmah in ama'n leng anamsau kisiatna in azang a asita hi.
Huchi in Saul asita a, atapa thumte; huan a-inkote tengteng leng asikhawm vek uhi.
Guam a om Israel mite tengteng in sepaihte taikek leh Saul leh atapate asi uh chih amuh un akhopite uh anusia ua, ataikekta uhi. Philistia mite ahong ua huaite ah atengta uhi.
Azingsang in hichi ahi a, thahsate puante suah ding a Philistia mite ahong pai lai un, Gilboa tang ah Saul leh atapate apuk uh chih amu uhi.
Huan amah vante asuah ua, alutang ala ua, agalvan leng, amilimte uh kiang leh mite kiang ah tanchin puak ding in Philistia mite gamsung ah akhak kimvel vek uhi.
Huchi in agalvan apathiante uh inn ah akoih ua, Dagon tempul ah alutang atak uhi.
Jabesh-gilead tengteng in Saul tung a Philistia mite thilhih tengteng azak un,
mihangsante tengteng athou ua, Saul luang leh atapate luang ava lamang ua, Jabesh ah ahon pua ua, Jabesh a tosaw sing nuai ah aguhte uh avui ua, ni sagih an angawl uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA tung a tatlekna hih a, TOUPA thu azuih louh a, dawi zawl aisan siam thu adot ziak in Saul asita hi.
Huai a thu kan a, TOUPA a kipan thu akan louh ziak in: huaiziak in amah athat a, lalgam Jesse tapa David kiang ah apeta hi.
